stemMd: Which claim would the second author most likely reject?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Officials need not judge artistic merit to allocate places.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Public space can accommodate diverse performers.

options.label: D
options.textMd: A schedule is fully fair merely because it makes no reference to musical style.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Noise limits can address conflicts among users.

explanationMd: The second passage focuses on disadvantages produced by ostensibly neutral procedures. Silence about style does not prevent access patterns from narrowing who performs.

distractorRationale.e: The second does not oppose that regulation.
distractorRationale.b: The second explicitly proposes nonartistic reforms.
